purpose: Teach: 激戦/欠損/直観/天災/幻覚/無期/呪縛/避妊

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、激戦地の遺物の盗難を警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: So with this case—a stolen artifact from a battle site—the police are actively investigating it, aren't they.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful observation. Leans slightly forward. Soft emphasis on 'stolen artifact.' Respectful of the officer's expertise. Curious but not presumptuous.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査資料に欠損がないか確認します
lines.en: We verify that our investigative documents don't have any gaps in them.
lines.style: Official but not cold. Matter-of-fact tone. Steady eye contact. Professional assurance without stiffness. Each phrase lands with quiet competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、直観だけに頼らず物的証拠を重視されますね、警察
lines.en: So in this case, the police rely on physical evidence rather than just intuition—that's important.
lines.style: Appreciative nod in the voice. Slower pace on 'physical evidence.' Genuine respect for method. Not flattering—observing something true with quiet admiration.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、天災時の防犯対応も整備しております
lines.en: We've put systems in place for crime prevention response during disasters too.
lines.style: Firm, straightforward delivery. Slight upward inflection—a statement of fact and competence. Professional pride without arrogance. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の幻覚症状を警察、医療と連携して確認されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police coordinate with medical professionals to assess whether the suspect is experiencing hallucinations—that kind of care in investigation.
lines.style: Quiet admiration in the pacing. Gentle emphasis on 'coordinate.' Slower on the clinical detail. Recognizing something holistic and human in a bureaucratic system.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、無期懲役判決事案も丁寧に対応します
lines.en: We handle cases resulting in life sentences with just as much care and attention.
lines.style: Composed, weighted delivery. Slight gravitas on 'life sentences.' Not defensive—stating a quiet principle. Measured breath. Professional commitment made personal.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の呪縛から解放するご支援を警察、なさってますね
lines.en: The police are helping victims move past the trauma that binds them to these cases.
lines.style: Soft, steady tone. 'Trauma' and 'binds' spoken with gentle weight. Slow cadence. Recognition of something tender within institutional care. Almost reverent.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、避妊用品の不正流通も捜査します
lines.en: We also investigate illegal distribution of contraceptive products.
lines.style: Slight tonal shift—more clipped, direct. Professional pivot to another duty. Not abrupt but matter-of-fact. Thorough and without apology.
